mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ANIME (anime_title, original_title, anime_year, anime_quarter, anime_story, anime_thumbnail_url, anime_genres, anime_tags) VALUES (#{animeTitle}, #{originalTitle}, #{animeYear}, #{animeQuarter}, #{animeStory}, #{animeThumbnailUrl}, #{animeGenres}, #{animeTags})
